description: Upcoming events in Puerto Rico as 787daily's /events/ page lists them: concerts, festivals, theater, sports, food and outdoor events announced in the island's press, and every town's patron-saint feast day (fiestas patronales). Filter by dates (an event counts when any of its days falls inside), town (accents optional) or category. Each event links its page, a calendar file and the story it came from. Dates are Puerto Rico calendar days; cite 787daily.com/events/.

category.description: One category, e.g. 'music', 'fiesta', 'arts', 'sports' (the answer lists them)

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (Puerto Rico); omit for today

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD; omit for no end

town.description: A municipio by name or slug, e.g. 'Ponce' or 'rio-grande'

name: get_events
